scope: S2 benchmark runner scratch cleanup exercised on macOS with inert Python child commands and the real CommandRecorder. Build, VM, performance, and device checks were outside this regression.

before.observation: The recorder observed exit 74 and terminal process custody and reported the injected stdout hash failure. The runner removed work/.

observations: Exit 74 with a stdout hash failure preserved work/ and propagated the recorder error.
Exit 74 with recorded logs preserved work/ and reported unresolved owner closure.
Exit 0 with a stdout hash failure removed work/ and propagated the recorder error.
Exit 0 with recorded logs removed work/ when the fixture stopped at frame validation.

cleanup: The command recorder observed terminal custody for the inert Python children. The tests removed their disposable fixture directories after asserting the runner cleanup behavior.
